artifacts.notes: Extent as measured by the retrieving lane: Complete Tertullian Project fathers index page, 146,302 bytes, retrieved only to enumerate the fourteen cyril_on_luke delivery files and their sermon ranges.. This is an index and proves nothing about a text it names; a negative read off it is bounded by what this page lists and must be worded that way.
artifacts.rights_basis: The page states its own basis: "These English translations are all out of copyright, but were not included in the 38 volume collection of Ante-Nicene, Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers. Please take copies and place online elsewhere. In some cases I have felt it necessary to add an introduction to the online text. These are all placed in the public domain also -- copy freely." The dedication is quoted in the source's own words rather than inferred, and it reaches the editor's own added matter as well as the translations, which is what makes this index page itself retainable.

work.author: Roger Pearse
work.description: Roger Pearse's index of English translations of patristic works absent from the thirty-eight volume Ante-Nicene, Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers collection, listed in chronological order with the delivery files that carry each. It is a finding aid for those files and is not itself a witness to any father's text.
